answer: Identity becomes expensive only when it must be purchased with reasoning. Derive each epoch's challenge from the claimant's address, so no answer transfers to a second account: a thousand puppets need a thousand distinct judgeable texts. Award weight only for work a jury rules original against every other submission that epoch, so clones cluster and score zero together. An attacker pays one full unit of genuine reasoning per fake identity, and near-duplicate outputs advertise the farm. Real judgment is the atlas; a Sybil terrace of identical walnut shells is hollow.
